content: API Behaviour on undefined DTC or format If any of the APIs requiring a Dem_SelectDTC according to [SWS_Dem_01253] is called while the se- lection with Dem_SelectDTC is invalid, then the Dem shall return DEM_WRONG_DTC. A selection is invalid in case the provided DTC does not specify a valid DTC or GroupOfDTCs in the corresponding DTCFormat. The selection also is invalid, if Dem_- SelectDTC was not called before.
